title: Snow Yam
wikitext:
{{Infobox |eng = Snow Yam |source = [[Hoes|Tilling]] • [[Winter Seeds]] |season = Winter |edibility = 12 |sellprice = 100 |xp = *[[Hoes|Tilling]]: 0 *[[Winter Seeds]]: 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] |color = White }} The '''Snow Yam''' is a [[foraging]] item found only in [[Winter]]. Wild snow yams do not grow above ground, but instead they are buried in the snow/dirt and must be dug up with a [[Hoes|Hoe]] (no other tools, even [[Crafting#Bombs|Bombs]], will work). The highest chance of finding a Snow Yam (11-16%, map-dependent) is when digging up an [[Artifact Spot]]. There is also a 4% chance of finding a Snow Yam when digging standard tillable soil in any exterior location. Exceptions are in [[the Farm]], where Snow Yams can be found at artifact spots, but not standard tillable soil, and in [[the Desert]], where Snow Yams can not be found at all. Digging up a Snow Yam provides no experience. Snow Yams can also be grown from [[Winter Seeds]], in which case they are a standard wild-seed crop: they grow above ground, can be harvested without using a tool, give 7 Foraging XP each, and are affected by the [[Skills#Foraging|Gatherer]] and [[Skills#Foraging|Botanist]] professions. Snow Yam can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Winter. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Robin,Demetrius,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Marnie,Gus,Sandy |hate=Maru |dislike=Sebastian,Pierre,Caroline,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Shane,Elliott,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus,Leo |like=Linus,Leah,Harvey }} ==Bundles== Snow Yam is used in the {{Bundle|Winter Foraging||y}}. ==Recipes== {| class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source !Sell Price |- |[[File:Winter Seeds.png|center]] |[[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds (Wi)]] ||{{Description|Winter Seeds}}
''(Produces 10 Winter Seeds per craft.)'' |{{Name|Crocus|1}}{{Name|Crystal Fruit|1}}{{Name|Snow Yam|1}}{{Name|Winter Root|1}} |[[File:Foraging Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Foraging]] Level 7 |{{Price|30}} |} ==Tailoring== Snow Yam is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a light blue [[Tailoring|Shirt]] [[File:Shirt044.png|24px]] with a horizontal white stripe in the middle. ==Quests== *The Snow Yam may be randomly requested in [[Winter]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|300}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. ==References== The chance of appearing in an artifact spot is calculated by GameLocation::digUpArtifactSpot. The base chance in code is 20% (0.5*0.4), but the actual chance is lower because artifacts and lost books are checked first and must all fail their checks. The chance of appearing in standard tillable soil is calculated by GameLocation::checkForBuriedItem. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].
